value.rationale: The result gives a complete classification of natural geometric and arithmetic centralizer invariants across an infinite family, and a sharp five-dimensional counterexample showing that even all-arity commuting schemes cannot determine nilpotency class or isoclinism. The counterexample is the substantive motivation for computing the full rank-only equivalence, beyond existing pair-variety component calculations.
